name: Reconciliation List 1
definition: Specifies a list of reconciliation information concerning financial items.

Date.name: Date
Date.definition: Date of creation of this document.

RelatedDocument.name: Related Document
RelatedDocument.definition: Reference to related documents for example to original assignment in a status response or retry.

PaymentMeans.name: Payment Means
PaymentMeans.definition: Set of elements used to further specify the type of transaction.

Item.name: Item
Item.definition: Financial item impacted by the payment.

ItemCount.name: Item Count
ItemCount.definition: Number of individual items contained in the list.

ControlSum.name: Control Sum
ControlSum.definition: Total of all individual amounts included in the list, irrespective of currencies.

AdditionalInformation.name: Additional Information
AdditionalInformation.definition: Additional proprietary formal information concerning the list.
